rationale: BLOCKED, no firm leaning. I read the complete held EO 12068 (43 FR 28971, June 30, 1978): sec. 1-101 makes sec. 5 of Reorganization Plan No. 1 of 1978 effective July 1, 1978 (a completed one-time act); sec. 1-102 says the functions transferred to the Attorney General under that section 'shall ... be performed in accordance with Department of Justice procedures heretofore followed under Section 707' of Title VII (a continuing direction). It has no sunset and no savings clause. History: empty catalog note and a 1989 Codification row 'Codified at Chapter 28, p. 468' (in the 1989 codification; not current status). The U.S. Code prints the order as a note to 42 U.S.C. 2000e-6 with no ending statement, which supports YES for sec. 1-102, but only as an unheld machine pointer checked through 2026-10-09. Because the order is half spent act and half continuing direction, the whole-order status needs a held current predicate and the plan text before I would propose either status.
